statement: Development example: a mounted panel subscribes to a persistent Subject; after synchronous unmount no panel subscription may remain in that primary Subject.

settle.statement: This example has no asynchronous application work; unsubscribe is synchronous and the scenario waits once more after the third unmount.

workloadChange.statement: The entry changes createApp(false) to createApp(true), enabling the existing unsubscribe at unmount. Scenario and application modules are identical.
